What I bring
From raw records to reliable insight.

Data quality, clear reporting, and decision support are central to my work.

I'm a data analytics professional with 10+ years of experience optimizing workflows, building analytical solutions, and delivering insights people can act on.

At La Sierra University I lead analytics for fundraising, alumni engagement, and reporting automation, and I led the migration from our legacy CRM to Slate. My day-to-day spans SQL and Python analysis, Power BI reporting, donor segmentation, predictive modeling, and data-integrity work.

I hold an MBA in Business Analytics from La Sierra University (3.96 GPA), where the School of Business named me Outstanding Graduate of the Year, and I'm an AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer.
